utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right, the repair drive! We're collecting old tools and things to fix up the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I've got some old wrenches and a hammer gathering dust—can I add them to the list too?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Old wrenches? Perfect! I think I have a rusty saw somewhere, if I can remember where I put it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've been going through the supply list for the repair drive, Noah. Do we know if anyone's offering duct tape or should I put out a request?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Duct tape? Uh, I think I might have a roll somewhere in the garage... or maybe that's packing tape. I'll check after I find my keys.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No rush, Noah. Let me know if you find it—I'll note it down. Otherwise, I can ask around.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Well, let me know if you need a hand with anything practical, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Leo! I’ll definitely call you if we need an extra pair of hands carrying lumber or holding things steady.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. Just holler.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Sam! I’m glad you’re here — are you still planning to bring by the old tools for the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'm still waiting on Alex to drop off the drive, but I'll have it ready for Saturday no matter what.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, that's a relief! I'll be home sorting donations all Saturday morning, so just swing by whenever you're ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, but can you show me the diagnostics? I'd feel better seeing the proof myself.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing, Kira—I've got the diagnostics right here. Want me to walk you through them over a cup of coffee?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Coffee sounds good, but I'll need to see those numbers before I take a sip.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You should bring something too, Eli! They're taking everything from toasters to old radios. It's such a great way to save some money.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, I've already got my post-hole digger ready for the fence repair. I'll be at the community center sharp at 10 a.m. Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, isn't that perfect timing! Maybe while you're fixing that fence, you can swing by my place and grab my toaster too—it's been on the fritz.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey, I haven't heard anything new yet—seems like it's still on for this weekend though.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it's still on! I've got the community center parking lot lined up for collection, and I'm keeping track of all the drop-off addresses.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, sounds like you've got it all organized! I'll spread the word when I'm out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Um, don't mind me. It's nothing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, okay, no worries—just let me know if you end up needing any of that duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I'll keep that in mind.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds great, Hana! How about we meet at the garden after school pickup tomorrow to take a look?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I could help with fixing things, if you need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's wonderful, Rey! We'd love your help. Let's all meet at the garden after school pickup tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, are you going to the repair drive? I'm planning to bring my old lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, wonderful Vik! We'd love to have you and that lawnmower — the more the merrier for Saturday morning at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm definitely bringing it—and my old blender and broken lamp too. Hope they can fix 'em all!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So you'll go grab it yourself if he doesn't show—good. What time should I come over to help with the repairs?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Right at 10 a.m. Saturday at the community center—I'll be there with extra gloves and coffee for everyone!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought we were fixing my porch, not the community center—did we change the plan?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Have we thought about assigning time slots? That might help avoid the driveway getting blocked.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That's a smart idea, Pia. I think if we each take a specific window, it keeps things running smooth.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, then should we draw up a quick schedule now? I can jot down who's coming when.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the gate at the park, just show me which tools to carry.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Do you know what tools we're supposed to bring? I don't want us to end up with duplicates.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Gus mentioned he has tools ready. Maybe we can coordinate with him.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Kira, I'm getting ready for the repair drive. Got my tools all set—want to help with that park gate?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure that repair drive is actually going to fix the problem, or are we just wasting our time?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey, I get the skepticism, but if we all chip in, we can make a real difference. The gate's been broken for weeks—it's worth a shot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I'm bringing my old toaster on Saturday — it's been popping up toast at all the wrong times!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Ha, sounds like it's got a mind of its own! I'm meeting Vik later to go over the list—want me to add your toaster to the fix-it queue?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that'd be perfect, Jules! Please do add it — the sooner that toaster learns some manners, the better!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Did you get a chance to look at those diagnostics Kira mentioned? I want to be sure we're on the right track before we start.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, I'm not sure about diagnostics, but I'm definitely bringing my old blender and broken lamp to the repair drive this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Vik, the repair drive is specifically for the community garden's water pump, not for household items like blenders. Did someone say we could bring other stuff?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, you're on top of it. Need me to come along when you go to his place?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Actually, Vik just told me Mrs. Chen is bringing her antique lamp too—sounds like a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, I asked if you need backup at Alex's—don't dodge the question.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Uli! Did you say something about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah, yeah, Gus has the toolbox ready—we're starting with Mrs. Henderson's fence post.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Mrs. Henderson's fence post? Right, right, I think I heard something about that... Sorry, I'm a bit behind.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds great, Hana! How about we meet at the garden after school tomorrow to check it out?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Faye, don't forget to spread the word about Saturday's repair drive! I'm counting on you to rally the morning crew.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, Quinn! I’ll hit up the school parents’ group tonight and round up a few early birds for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Uli! Just a heads-up, I'm collecting tools for the repair drive this Saturday — Oren mentioned he might have some old ones to donate.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh. Saturday. I'll see what I can find in the shed, but no promises.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Uli! Even if you just find one thing, it'll be appreciated. I'll be at home sorting on Saturday if you want to drop them by.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, sounds like a solid plan. I'll bring my post-hole digger and be there sharp at 10.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds like we're all set—Alex's drive should be here by noon, so we'll have everything we need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, noon works for the equipment drop. I'll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Leo, have you heard about the repair drive? I just found out from Cleo—it sounds like a great way to get to know folks around here.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Haven't heard of any repair drive. What exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, it's not about fixing one specific thing—it's more like a community swap for spare parts and tools. Cleo's keeping a list of what everyone's offering.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We're still on for Saturday, Mara! Opal just suggested the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, and don't forget—it's the lot behind the center, not the front one, so folks won't get confused.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Good catch, Opal—I'll make sure the flyers mention the back lot. Now, what about setting up a sign-in table near the entrance?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Rusty pliers? That sounds perfect! I'll dig through my garage too and see what I can find.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Oren, let's make a list later—gotta run, but duct tape is key, got it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Duct tape! Right, I'll add that to my mental list. See you later, Bo!

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
